name: Town buffer bots
description: Paid buffer BOTS (Prophet personas of bots-core, like on Gleb's x100 server) sitting at the gatekeepers of Gludio 48, Dion 55, Giran 64, Aden 74, Goddard 78: trade them the price in adena (stock trade window, hook P6-BOT-TRADE) and they cast the full Prophet set for a mage or a warrior (by the payer's class) at the skill levels of a Prophet of that level; stock 20 min. Needs bots-core (solo).

PriceMultiplier.description: Price of a full set x this (the title shows the real price after a relog of the bot).

TradeTimeout.description: An open trade window without a deal is cancelled after this (old server: 60 s).

AnswerDelay.description: Pause before the bot accepts a trade request and before it confirms (old server: 1 s).

BuffWait.description: A paid customer farther than CastRange is waited for this long, then the rest of the set is dropped.

CastRange.description: The bot does not walk: it buffs a customer within this distance (old server: 900).

StandMpPercent.description: Out of MP while buffing: sits until this much MP (old server: 80).
